channel.title: Federal Compliance on DefectDojo Documentation
channel.description: Recent content in Federal Compliance on DefectDojo Documentation

item.title: Compliance Profile
item.description: The Compliance Profile enrolls an Asset as a system and holds the facts that appear on every deliverable it produces. Open the Asset that represents your system boundary, go to the Compliance tab, then Profile.

item.title: The POA&M Ledger
item.description: POA&M items are created and updated automatically from findings. The sync runs shortly after imports and finding changes, and a nightly sweep catches anything that slipped through. You can also add items by hand, for weaknesses that no scanner reports.

item.title: ConMon Snapshots
item.description: On the Snapshots tab, Generate Snapshot produces the deliverables for a reporting period. A snapshot freezes the ledger as of that moment: later edits never change a deliverable you have already generated.

item.title: Remediation Deadlines
item.description: Two ready-made SLA configurations ship with the feature. Assign either to your Assets from SLA configuration settings, or copy one and adjust it.

item.title: CMMC Level 2 Assessments
item.description: The Compliance tab can score a CMMC Level 2 self-assessment against NIST 800-171 Rev 2, using the DoD Assessment Methodology point weights.

item.title: Control Coverage
item.description: The control coverage view answers a simple question: which 800-53 controls do my scanners actually test, and where are the open weaknesses per control?
